CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting
  June 8, 2021

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

  •  ROLL CALL:
  Present: Ankit Udani, Jose Luis Espinoza, Stanley Tsai
  Absent: Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez
  Staff Present: Rick Abe AIA, Erin Ung, Vist Yang

DISCUSSION AGENDA:

ITEM 1:
APPLICANT: 300 East Alhambra Road

Recommended Action: approval as submitted.

The applicant Vincent Chen was present for Item number 1 and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments.
There were no comments submitted by email prior to the meeting

Tsai questioned the difference between the solid site wall and the open wrought iron fence. The
applicant stated that the issue arose due to the condition of the concrete subterranean structure
beneath grade level. The soil for landscape was needed for the trees and landscape and justified
the solid wall lining a portion of the site

Udani confirmed that he was not within the 300’ radius and was supportive of the project.

MOTION:
 •  Jose Luis Espinoza moved to approve the application as submitted
 •  Second was by Ankit Udani
 •  The motion carried by the following 3-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Jose Luis Espinoza, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez

  1
 ITEM 2:
APPLICANT: 1139 West Main Street

Recommended Action: approval as submitted.

The applicant Julianne Chiang was present for Item number 2 and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments.
There were no comments submitted by email prior to the meeting.

Espinoza stated that the BMW aesthetic was acceptable and supported the architectural exterior
revisions.

Tsai questioned the method for louver attachment to the building.

The applicant responded by stating that the vertical supporting structure includes the 5 existing
columns which support a new horizontal frame for the louver support. The color of the fins is a
clear anodized aluminum to match the building.

Udani questioned one of the photos of the materials used and the applicant stated that the photos
were for general illustrative purposes and the incidental information in the photo was not site
specific.

MOTION:
 •  Jose Luis Espinoza moved to approve the application as submitted.
 •  Seconded by Ankit Udani.
 •  The motion carried by the following 3-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Jose Luis Espinoza, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez

ITEM 3:
APPLICANT: 1116 South Valencia Street

Recommended Action: approval with the condition that the dimensions and details for the new
driveway gate shall be provided and reviewed by DRB staff prior to building plan check submittal.

The applicant Perry Chan was present for Item number 3 and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments.
There were no comments submitted by email prior to the meeting.

The applicant stated that he would provide the requested detail drawing to the planning department
after the DRB. He then shared the image of the detail with the Board.

Espinoza agreed with the condition and supported the project.

  2
 Tsai stated that the AC condensers should be relocated to avoid visibility from the street.

The applicant stated that the two condensers could be relocated to the rear yard or the driveway
side elevation. Udani commented that the condensers could still be visible in the driveway. The
applicant confirmed that he would relocate them to the rear yard.

Udani also questioned the windows and configuration. The applicant stated that he would be
replacing the windows with Milgard windows and he would have a consistent header height.

MOTION:
 •  Jose Luis Espinoza moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1) the
  AC condensers shall be relocated to the rear yard and; 2) the driveway gate detail shall be
  provided to staff prior to building permit submittal.
 •  Seconded by Ankit Udani.
 •  The motion carried by the following 3-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Jose Luis Espinoza, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez

PUBLIC COMMENTS/ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:
• There were no public comments or oral communications.

ADJOURNMENT:
MOTION:
 •  Jose Luis Espinoza moved to adjourn the meeting at 7:55
 •  Seconded by Stanley Tsai.
 •  The motion carried by the following 3-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Jose Luis Espinoza, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 9th day of November, 2021.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman
ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
